name: Explicit Sampling for Point Cloud Extraction
definition: A method to extract a point cloud (PC) from a Probabilistic Directed Distance Field (PDDF) by projecting random points onto the shape surface S. It does not guarantee uniform sampling over S.
summary: Explicit Sampling extracts point clouds from distance fields by projecting uniformly sampled points onto surfaces using a shoot-and-cast strategy, which differs from other methods by not guaranteeing uniform sampling density.
